web_merchants_b_walk_v1.review: Only selected single stride poses. Repeated neighbouring original rows are not counted as animation phases. Ruan Xiaoer uses source row2 to avoid top-edge hat uncertainty.

web_merchants_b_passing_v1.review: Partial source accepted only for individually intact selected bodies. Ruan7 NW and Bai NW are visibly merged at alpha>99 and forbidden; first row is superseded by separate Ruan2 passing. No anatomy splitting or padded hat repair.

web_ruan_xiaoer_passing_v2.review: Independent view accepted full headwrap and feet, 2x2 genuine SE/SW/NE/NW, cloth identity and drawn close-foot passing posture.

web_ruan7_bai_nw_passing_v2.review: Independent view accepted two separate full NW figures, left Ruan7 and right Bai, actual back-left facing with passing feet. No shared pixel bridge; replaces rejected merged NW bodies in B passing sheet.
